name: autopilot-marketing
description: Open-source ad operations engine for your own AI agent: evidence-backed audits, reviewable change plans and guarded execution, with typed judgments from Jev.

interface.shortDescription: Audit ad accounts, prepare reviewable change plans and apply only what a person approved.
interface.longDescription: Autopilot Marketing gives your own AI agent tools to audit ad accounts, prepare reviewable changes and apply only what a person approved. It reads Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, Search Console and Mautic, runs deterministic checks with the evidence behind every finding, and stores each proposed change as a plan of typed actions that can be previewed, dry-run, applied and reverted. Live changes need an approval given by a person outside the conversation, or the owner's auto-apply policy. Judgments come from Jev (TypeSafe System One) when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set; otherwise they are labelled rule-based fallbacks that are signals for review, never decisions. Demo accounts are available out of the box.
defaultPrompt: Audit the demo-google account and show the top findings with their evidence.
Build a period-over-period report for demo-meta.
Classify the search terms in demo-google and draft a plan of negative keywords for me to review.
